title: A Hybrid Information Flow Analysis Framework for Android Hybrid Apps
abstract: arXiv:2610.27288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The WebView interface in Android (hybrid) applications enables the native side (e.g., Java) to exchange data with the Web (e.g., JavaScript). This creates cross-language information flow channels that existing single-language analyzers cannot analyze. Existing hybrid app analyses address only part of the problem: some build bridge-aware call graphs but provide limited information-flow analysis, some rely on coarse assumptions, and some focus only on web vulnerabilities. We present MifDroid, a static-analysis- guided dynamic-analysis framework with a lifecycle-aware per-WebView call graph, a bridge-aware type-and-effect system, and a modular JavaScript analysis engine. We evaluated MifDroid on 338 apps from the F-Droid repository (out of 4,126 total) that use addJavascriptInterface, enabling active communication between Java and JavaScript. translated_title: 面向Android混合应用的混合信息流分析框架
translated_abstract: Android（混合）应用中的WebView接口使得原生端（如Java）能够与Web端（如JavaScript）交换数据。这产生了现有单语言分析器无法分析的跨语言信息流通道。现有的混合应用分析方法只解决了部分问题：一些方法构建了感知桥接的调用图但信息流分析能力有限，一些方法依赖粗糙的假设，还有一些只关注Web漏洞。我们提出了MifDroid，一个由静态分析引导的动态分析框架，它包含生命周期感知的每WebView调用图、桥接感知的类型-效果系统以及模块化的JavaScript分析引擎。我们在F-Droid仓库中使用addJavascriptInterface的338个应用（总计4,126个）上评估了MifDroid，这些应用实现了Java和JavaScript之间的主动通信。我们的引导动态阶段在静态分析产生的444个条目基础上新增了662个条目，提升了分辨率……
tldr: MifDroid是一个静态分析引导动态分析的混合框架，通过生命周期感知的WebView调用图、桥接感知的类型-效果系统和模块化JavaScript分析引擎，解决了Android混合应用中Java与JavaScript之间跨语言信息流无法被单语言分析器检测的问题。
en_tdlr: MifDroid is a static-analysis-guided dynamic analysis framework that tackles cross-language information flow between Java and JavaScript in Android hybrid apps using a lifecycle-aware per-WebView call graph, a bridge-aware type-and-effect system, and a modular JavaScript analysis engine.
